data.body:
[P1] Do not deserialize callback-selected exception classes

A callback failure is supplied by the external holder of the callback ID, but this call feeds its `errorType` to `Class.forName` and its `errorData` to the configured SerDes. A sender can initialize any local class and, for `Throwable` types, invoke Jackson/custom-SerDes construction. Keep external callback errors opaque inside `CallbackFailedException`, or require an explicit allowlist/typed error decoder before reconstructing a cause.
